sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('b283d662-9be1-49c7-be03-cb21055314c1', '4f600112-168a-4a58-9914-7c01f71894da') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
